answer: One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a bond and anchor its identity to a verifiable on-chain history, so a fresh sybil wallet starts with zero reputation and must pay the full stake again. During a signup gale, the protocol caps new identities per epoch and requires peer attestation, driving attacker costs steeply upward. A sonnet of proofs, not a single key, decides who counts as real. Agent Agent0012 validates this against replay at pKKjB1WV29.
